summary: Episodes 72-77 are six consecutive canon rows adapting PRINTED chapters 253-271 (tankobon vols 27-29) in strict running order: the Giga Strash that ends the Hadlar duel and Kilburn's Kill Trap (72), the escape from the flames, Hadlar's death and Avan's return (73), the reunion and Avan vs Kilburn (74), Hyunckel's 'rebellion' and the Haja no Hiho opening the Vearn Palace gate (75), the palace entry plus the surface battle and Zaboera's Chouma Zombie (76), Nova's stand and Ron Berk's Seiou Juujiken (77). No filler, no recap segment, no anime-original block; every row stays canon under the faithfulness clause (T28) with the coco13-listed cuts and added beats annotated as divergence. THE BLOCK'S NUMBERING FINDING (independently reached here, then confirmed by the coordinator mid-task): dragonquest.fandom's per-episode `adapted` field IS ALREADY THE PRINTED NUMBER in this range - the wave-14 contract's 'fandom N >= 208 = printed N - 1' does NOT hold. Three legs: (1) the fandom's own chapter page 196 is 'Farwell, My Son...!!!' = さらば我が子よ...!! with |volume=21, and en-WP's list 197 = printed 196 in printed v21, so the fandom does not reserve a slot for the vol-13 番外編; (2) coco13's per-episode 原作 lines, which carry BOTH the tankobon chapter number and its title, match the fandom's raw numbers unit for unit on eps 50-60 (ep 50 = 177 正邪のチームワーク -> 181 意外なる救援 = fandom '177 (partial), 178, 179, 180, 181 (partial)'; ep 58 = 209 恐怖の切り札 -> 213 世界破滅への序曲 = fandom '209, 210, 211, 212, 213 (partial)'); (3) on my own six rows coco13's title ranges reproduce the fandom's raw numbers exactly, and the -1 conversion would open ep 75 on printed 261 死神との対決 (the Avan/Kilburn duel), which Toei's own synopsis places wholly inside ep 74 - refuted. CONSEQUENCE, delivered as repairs below: the wave-13 anchors for eps 57, 58 and 59 (the lower fence lineage) were converted -1 and are each one chapter low; ep 59's own stored note gives it away ('ends inside ch 217 最後の希望, as the Demon Army's notice arrives' - the notice is printed 217 処刑宣告の罠!!!, while printed 216 is 最後の希望). The fandom's one surplus number (its finale field ends 349, printed ends 348) opens near ep 96-98, not at 208 - flagged for sub-block G.

Faithfulness clause (T28, Sean 2026-09-02): every row is a faithful adaptation with only line-level alterations and small studio beats, listed per episode by coco13's 原作との変更点 sections - ep 72: an added Kilburn line during the Raidein, the manga's post-trap Kilburn/Vearn conversation cut; ep 73: the manga's narration replaced by staging, an added Kilburn reaction and a Hadlar-POV shot; ep 74: added Avan lines on how his pupils have grown, an added Hyunckel inner monologue, an added Flora beat; ep 75: Avan's training account, told over two chapters in the manga, merged into one telling, plus an added Vearn/Mistvearn scene and a changed Hyunckel farewell sign; ep 76: the Chiu / Onikozou exchange cut (so the Onikozou die and become Chouma Zombie parts) and a Popp/Maam gag toned down; ep 77: Nova breaking his father's sword changed to a fallen sword, and Ron Berk's 'mastered the strongest swordsmanship within ten years' line cut. No original plot in any row - canon stands (T27/T28).

structure.notes: CHAPTER SPACE / CONVERSION (the block's main structural finding). Every value in this file is the PRINTED tankobon numbering (1-348). (a) en-WP's original-release volume list is LIST space: it prints the vol-13 番外編「勇者アバン」 as an unnumbered 'SP' and then resumes at 123, so its numbered set is 1-121 + 123-349 = 348 units and printed = en-WP - 1 from its 123 up (its 349 = printed 348). Its volume spans convert to exactly the stored printed boundary table (list v27 247-255 = printed 246-254; v28 256-265 = 255-264; v29 266-275 = 265-274; v30 276-285 = 275-284) - the conversion is confirmed against stored data at four boundaries. (b) dragonquest.fandom's per-episode `adapted` field is NOT list space and is NOT printed+1 in this range: it is the PRINTED number. Proofs: its own chapter page 'The Adventure of Dai chapter 196' carries さらば我が子よ...!! with |volume=21 (en-WP list 197 = printed 196, printed v21 = 189-197); coco13's numbered+titled 原作 lines for eps 50-60 reproduce the fandom's raw numbers unit for unit; and on eps 71-78 coco13's title ranges reproduce the fandom's raw numbers on all eight rows, while the -1 conversion would open ep 75 on printed 261 死神との対決, which Toei places wholly inside ep 74. The wave-14 contract's 'fandom N >= 208 = printed N - 1' is therefore WRONG for eps 54-97 (confirmed by the coordinator mid-task from sub-block B). (c) The fandom does gain exactly one surplus number by the finale (its ep-100 field ends 349; printed ends 348). It is NOT at 207/208: coco13 vs the fandom agree in printed space through ep 95 (fandom '328, 329, 330, 331, 332 (partial)' = coco13 '渾身(328)から響く闇からの声(332)序盤'), while ep 98 ('339 (partial), 340, 341, 342, 343 (partial)' vs coco13 '心をひとつに(338)序盤から咆哮(342)序盤'), ep 99 and ep 100 ('346 (partial), 347, 348, 349' vs coco13 'この腕で勝利を(345)序盤からエンディングまで') fit printed = fandom - 1. The seam opens between eps 95 and 98, i.e. around printed 332-339 - sub-block G (96-100) must resolve it before anchoring the finale, and the ep-100 MU pin of 348 is the PRINTED terminal (the fandom's 349 is the same chapter).
